nontraining.development_policy: Use preregistered affected-condition subsets plus original regression for intermediate candidates. Do not spend on all16blocks at every checkpoint. Exact subset branches must be frozen before observing the baseline. Final coverage remains unchanged.

measurement_logging_proposal.evaluation: Full clean/delivered frames, validity/times/RNG identity including resets; v2 may reference or XOR the immediately preceding decoded frame, all arrays hash checked; v1 preserved.
measurement_logging_proposal.training: Draft finite-field policy: per-lane clean/delivered minimum/valid count/timestamps/full tensor hashes every policy step, full measurement windows for first rollout and registered boundary/failure windows; all actual exposure/reward/termination/q/ICS recorded. Windows and caps must be frozen and independently accepted. No deletion of negative outcomes.
measurement_logging_proposal.unresolved: Training failure-window upper count, byte allocation, exact physics-force logging, reset/start/init/checkpoint/cleanup quotas and evidence-audit coverage must be implemented before capacity_pass=true.

live_guard: Each output reservation includes measured bytes and remaining quota; quota-before-write abort preserves failure evidence without borrowing final reserve. A fixture estimate never authorizes exceeding128GiB.
